fields.label: Master Email Enabled
fields.description: Master kill switch - uncheck to disable ALL email notifications immediately

fields.label: Email Mode
fields.description: Active: Normal operation. Paused: All emails held until pause_until. Scheduled: Emails batched for scheduled delivery.

fields.label: Pause Until
fields.description: Emails will automatically resume after this datetime

fields.label: Pause Reason
fields.description: Optional: Why emails are paused (for audit trail)

fields.label: Admin Notification Emails
fields.description: Comma-separated email addresses for general admin notifications

fields.label: Financial Admin Emails
fields.description: Comma-separated email addresses for SEPA, payment, and financial notifications

fields.label: System Alert Emails
fields.description: Comma-separated email addresses for system alerts (stuck schedules, errors, etc.)

fields.label: Fallback Admin Role
fields.description: Role to use when no specific recipients are configured

fields.label: Notification Types
fields.description: Registry of all notification types with individual enable/disable controls

fields.label: Default Retry Attempts
fields.description: Number of retry attempts for failed email delivery

fields.label: Batch Size
fields.description: Maximum emails to send in a single batch

fields.label: Rate Limit Per Hour
fields.description: Maximum emails to send per hour (0 = unlimited)

fields.label: Enable Audit Logging
fields.description: Log notification events for audit trail

fields.label: Use Frappe Notifications
fields.description: Enable integration with Frappe's native Notification system

fields.label: Respect User Preferences
fields.description: Honor user-level notification opt-outs when using Frappe Notifications

fields.label: Suppress During Imports
fields.description: Automatically suppress notifications during CSV imports and bulk operations
